question: The ‘Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh’ was founded in which of the following districts of Maharashtra?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagpur.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS):**

 
 
• Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) also called Rashtriya Seva Sangh, **organization founded in 1925 by Keshav Baliram Hedgewar.**
 
• The RSS presents itself as** a cultural, not a political, organization** that nevertheless advocates a Hindu nationalistic agenda under the banner of** Hindutva.**
 
• The idea was to train the Hindu youths so that they** united the Hindu Community and make India an Independent undivided country.**
 
• He was much **influenced by V D Savarkar and adopted his ideals.**
 
• **The Headquarters of Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) is located at Nagpur.**
 
• Keshav Baliram Hedgewar was **born on 1st April 1889, at Nagpur.**
 
• **The first Shakha of the Sangh was started with a handful of youth at Nagpur.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Keshav Baliram Hedgewar (1 April 1889 – 21 June 1940) was the founding Sarsanghachalak of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh(RSS).
 
• Hedgewar founded the RSS in Nagpur in 1925, based on the ideology of Hindutva with the intention of creating a Hindu Rashtra.
 
• Hedgewar was born on 1 April 1889 in a Telugu-speaking.
